blind.description: A stylized wooden architectural bracket or corbel consisting of an upright vertical timber post, a horizontal cantilevered arm, and a curved diagonal brace supporting the arm from beneath. Two cylindrical wooden pegs or dowels are visible on the joint faces. The model features clean, continuous geometry with stylized hand-painted brown wood grain textures and soft beveled edges.
blind.from_above: A straight brown horizontal rectangular beam joined to a squarish post cap showing stylized circular wood grain rings, with two small rounded peg ends protruding slightly on the sides.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall and 2.5 feet wide, roughly two-fifths the height of the 5 ft 9 in marker figure.
